title: Document focused stats and chart workflows
description: Update README, embedded wtp help, CLI reference text, examples, and the Unreleased changelog. Document singular selectors, the status-before-model compatibility form, --chart placement, the --chart/--json conflict, fixed-width scaled bars, (unset) models, rolling half-open 24-hour ranges, UTC boundaries, and the precise meaning of progressed as latest UpdatedAt. Include examples for status counts, model counts across all tasks and one status, and created/progressed ranges. Remove the claim that stats supports exactly four forms. Keep agent-facing guidance centered on JSON and human-facing guidance centered on optional charts. Run documentation contract tests, go test ./..., and git diff --check.
